item: The heavy diagnostics GETs are POSTs, and their buttons save the answer as a file (R278 F1/P2 adopted by R694)
key_paths: src/api/diagnostics/performance.py; src/api/diagnostics/evals.py; src/api/diagnostics/bundle.py; src/static/oo-on.js; src/static/index.html; tests/test_get_cross_site_refusal.py; tests/data/diagnostics_routes_at_split.json
summary: 21 diagnostics routes (performance, benchmark, rollup-benchmark, llm-bench, llm-throughput, source-coverage-benchmark, recursive-loop, /all, /debug-bundle and the twelve self-tests) and /api/signals/fdr-selftest answer only POST; a GET is 405 before any handler, so another site's page can no longer start minutes of CPU, memory or local-model work. The four buttons that opened them in a tab call the new ooPostSave helper, which posts and saves the answer. The bundle coverage check counts the moved report routes through _DIAG_REPORT_POSTS so none drops out of it; the GET walk's floor is 461 full and 458 Core-only.
